providers.title: Elementary facts on tilings
providers.scope: Tiles and fully periodic tiling sets are preserved by translations and isomorphisms; A (+) H = G for a subgroup H exactly when A meets every coset once; fully periodic sets are finite unions of cosets of a finite-index subgroup. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Newman's theorem
providers.scope: Every tiling set of Z by a finite tile is invariant under a translation by some p >= 1. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Subgroups of Z^d
providers.scope: A subgroup of Z^d of index M contains M Z^d; a subgroup containing d linearly independent vectors has finite index. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unit-cube thickening
providers.scope: A tiling set of Z^d by T is an almost-everywhere tiling set of R^d by T + [0,1]^d, fully periodic if invariant under a finite-index subgroup. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A tile in Z^3 with no periodic tiling (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A finite T in Z^3 tiles Z^3 with no tiling set invariant under a finite-index subgroup, and T + [0,1]^3 tiles R^3 almost everywhere with no tiling set invariant under a lattice of full rank; proved in the last lesson. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Global affine approximation
providers.scope: An array with the line rule (p > 200) agrees with a nonzero affine form An + Bm + C over F_p wherever the form is nonzero. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Vertical nondegeneracy
providers.scope: The columns are nonconstant exactly when B != 0, and then every positive vertical period is divisible by p. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The vertical-period obstruction
providers.scope: No array with the line rule and no constant column has a positive vertical period. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The last-nonzero-digit model
providers.scope: The array W(n,m) = f(m), with f the last nonzero digit in base p, satisfies the line rule and every column takes every value. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A cyclic finite group
providers.scope: V = Z/p^4 x prod (Z/r_i^2 x Z/a_i x Z/b_i) is cyclic. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Invariance tiles
providers.scope: For a channel i and a shift sigma there is a tile F with A (+) F = G exactly when c_i(b - sigma) = c_i(b) for all bases b, for every graph A. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exclusion of simultaneous activity
providers.scope: For a cycle of channels with chosen labels, finitely many tiles are tiled by a graph exactly when at every x one of the labels is inactive. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Activation fibre criterion
providers.scope: A graph tiles with an activation tile exactly when the batch maps are bijections at every target base. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ordinary activation
providers.scope: In every common solution every ordinary channel has an active label at every point. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Seed activation
providers.scope: In every common solution each seed is active at some point. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No fully periodic common solution
providers.scope: No common solution of the system is invariant under a subgroup of finite index. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Block inverse
providers.scope: The map (l, delta) -> (C(k - l) + e_delta, T(x_1 - h_1)(k - l)) is a bijection from K x Delta onto P x K. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A system with a common solution and no periodic one (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Finitely many finite tiles in Z^2 x V, V finite cyclic, have a common solution but no fully periodic common solution. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Partitions with full difference sets
providers.scope: For every s and every finite set of primes there are a prime q outside it and a partition of Z/q into s sets E with E - E = Z/q. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Stacking
providers.scope: Finite tiles F_1, ..., F_s have a common solution exactly when the stacked tile tiles H x Z/q, and full periodicity passes in both directions. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One tile with a cyclic finite coordinate
providers.scope: A finite tile of Z^2 x Z/Q has a tiling set but no fully periodic one. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rigid representatives
providers.scope: For some m >= 2 there is a transversal modulo m whose points other than the marked one have every difference d with |d| <= m outside m Z^3. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Existence of tilings
providers.scope: The tile T tiles Z^3 and its thickening tiles R^3 almost everywhere. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Grid centers
providers.scope: In a periodic almost-everywhere tiling by the two constituent shapes, the centers form a translate of m Z^3. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No fully periodic tiling of R^3
providers.scope: No almost-everywhere tiling of R^3 by the thickening of T has a tiling set invariant under a lattice of full rank. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
